title: Trump v Obama - which president has the star power to get out the vote?
description: The BBC's Sarah Smith followed the current and former presidents as both parties hope their biggest names can drive midterm turnout.
text: As President Donald Trump and former President Barack Obama hit the campaign trail for Republican and Democratic candidates, both parties are hoping their star power can boost turnout in a critical midterm election.
The BBC's Sarah Smith attended rallies in Michigan featuring both men to ask attendees which president they think can still get voters to the polls.
